description: Ex-USAAF SB-17G 44-85583 (Lockheed-Vega c/n 8492), FAB 5402 of the Recife SAR unit 1953-1968; displayed at the base gate since March 1973, restored 1999. Base Aérea do Recife was deactivated 11/24 July 2024 and the gate monuments passed to CINDACTA III custody (Poder Aéreo); still listed Feb 2026.
museum_name: Base Aérea do Recife and CINDACTA III Aircraft Displays

museum_name: Base Aérea do Recife and CINDACTA III Aircraft Displays

description: Xavante inside the former base, painted as 4570 (ABRAPAC 2019; Feb 2026 list). The serial 4570 is also reported at Museu EPCAR Guaramiranga (2024) and was listed at Porto Velho in 2019, so the marking here may be duplicated; true identity unknown.
museum_name: Base Aérea do Recife and CINDACTA III Aircraft Displays
